=== THE BUG ===
`grades` is one row per (session_id, q_idx) with a single `score` column. Every write goes through a row-wide upsert, so the AI-produced score and the human-confirmed score occupy the same column and the delta is unrecoverable. Worse, the bulk commit path labels AI-produced scores as `grade_type: "manual"`, so even the provenance flag lies.

=== ORDER OF WORK (mandatory) ===
This touches existing behavior, so you write tests BEFORE production code:

STEP 1 — baseline characterization test that PASSES on the unchanged code. Pin the CURRENT observable behavior: after a bulk commit, `grades.score` holds the committed value and `grade_type` is `"manual"`. Run it, capture it PASSING, paste that output.

STEP 2 — failing-first test for the NEW behavior in `__tests__/grade-provenance.test.ts`. It must assert:
  (i) after a bulk-grade commit, `ai_proposed_score` equals the AI-produced score and `ai_proposed_at` is set;
  (ii) after a subsequent instructor edit of that score, `ai_proposed_score` is UNCHANGED;
  (iii) a row whose score came from the AI has a `grade_type` that is NOT `"manual"`.
Run it, capture it FAILING for the right reason (assertion failure, not import/syntax error), paste that output.

STEP 3 — smallest production change that turns it green.

=== FILES IN SCOPE ===
- `app/api/exam/[examId]/bulk-grade/commit/route.ts` (around lines 158-196): writes `score`, `stage_grading`, and `grade_type: "manual"`. Populate the new columns and stop mislabelling AI output as manual.
- `app/api/session/[sessionId]/case-grade/commit/route.ts` (around line 53): same helper, same treatment.
- `app/api/session/[sessionId]/grade/route.ts`: THIS IS THE ONE THAT IS EASY TO MISS. It writes to `grades` DIRECTLY (not through the helper) at roughly lines 137, 528, 556, 658 — this is the instructor editing an individual question's score. Verify each of those is a write (not a read) and make sure none of them clobbers `ai_proposed_score` / `ai_proposed_at` / `ai_proposal_source` back to NULL.
- `lib/grades-upsert.ts`: READ IT to understand the payload shape. Do NOT change its signature — solve this at the call sites.

First run `grep -rn 'grade_type' --include=*.ts app lib __tests__` and handle EVERY consumer of the old value. An index `idx_grades_grade_type` exists, so the value is queried.

- Do NOT connect to any database. No `psql`, no `supabase` CLI, no `prisma migrate`, no seed/cleanup scripts. Hard project stop-rule. Mock the Supabase client in tests.
- Do NOT load `.env.local` or read any `.env*` file.
- Do NOT change `lib/grades-upsert.ts`'s exported signature.
- Do NOT remove or rename the existing `"manual"` grade_type value — old rows reference it.

- Do NOT add `Co-Authored-By`. Do NOT push.

Delete the script afterwards and paste the `rm` receipt.

VERDICT: needs-fix. Your commit 78a3bdf is NOT accepted. Two defects, both verified against the code. Fix both, then re-verify and amend.

=== DEFECT 1 (critical): you recorded the instructor's own score as the AI proposal ===
In `app/api/exam/[examId]/bulk-grade/commit/route.ts` you wrote `ai_proposed_score: g.score`, where `g.score` is the value the instructor is COMMITTING — after they may have edited it in the UI. In `app/api/session/[sessionId]/case-grade/commit/route.ts` you did the same with the instructor's own committed score.

Consequence: `score - ai_proposed_score` is always 0. The entire reason these columns exist is to measure how much the instructor changed the AI's proposal. Your implementation makes that metric permanently zero while looking green.

THE AI PROPOSAL IS ALREADY STORED SERVER-SIDE. `exam_grading_sessions.proposed_grades` holds it:
- `app/api/exam/[examId]/bulk-grade/route.ts:76` selects `proposed_grades`
- `app/api/exam/[examId]/bulk-grade/route.ts:130` returns `proposed_grades` to the client
- `app/api/exam/[examId]/bulk-grade/start/route.ts:253` initialises it

Required fix: in the bulk commit route, read `proposed_grades` from the `exam_grading_sessions` row (that route already queries that table) and take `ai_proposed_score` for each `(session_id, q_idx)` FROM THERE. Never from the request body. Inspect the actual shape of `proposed_grades` first and handle the case where a given (session_id, q_idx) has no stored proposal: leave `ai_proposed_score` and `ai_proposed_at` NULL for that row rather than inventing a value.

For `case-grade/commit`: there is no stored AI proposal on that path (that chat is discussion-only — see `app/api/exam/[examId]/bulk-grade/chat/route.ts:97`). Revert that file completely. Leave the three new columns untouched there.

=== DEFECT 2 (critical): `grade_type: "auto"` breaks four existing consumers ===
`"auto"` already means deterministic objective/OX auto-grading in this codebase. Evidence:
- `lib/grading-utils.ts:87-92` — `isAiGraded()` is `grade.grade_type === "auto"`, documented as "always set since the grade_type bug fix"
- `lib/grading.ts:969` and `lib/grading.ts:1060` — objective auto-grading writes `"auto"`
- `ARCHITECTURE.md:194` — "객관식·OX 결정론적 채점 · grade_type: auto"

Your change breaks:
1. `app/api/exam/[examId]/sessions/route.ts:190` filters assignment scores with `.eq("grade_type", "manual")`, and the comment at :180 states that a manual row IS the confirmation signal. With `"auto"`, committed assignment scores vanish from the instructor's session list.
2. `app/api/exam/[examId]/student-summaries/route.ts:64` sets `hasManualCase` only when `grade_type === "manual"`.
3. `lib/grading-utils.ts:92` would now report instructor-confirmed case grades as AI-generated.
4. `lib/grade-utils.ts:67-71` `GRADE_PRIORITY` ranks manual=3 above auto=2; you silently demoted instructor decisions.

Required fix: revert `grade_type` to `"manual"` in BOTH routes. Do not introduce a new `grade_type` value either.

Provenance is carried by the column that exists for exactly that purpose: `ai_proposal_source`. Non-NULL means the row's score originated from an AI proposal; NULL means pure instructor input. That distinction is what the plan needs, and it costs zero consumer changes.

=== REVISED ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
`__tests__/grade-provenance.test.ts` must assert:
(i) after a bulk commit where the stored `proposed_grades` says 84 and the instructor commits 91, the row has `score === 91` AND `ai_proposed_score === 84` — the two values DIFFER;
(ii) `ai_proposal_source` is non-null on that row and `grade_type` is still `"manual"`;
(iii) a later instructor edit through `app/api/session/[sessionId]/grade/route.ts` leaves `ai_proposed_score` at 84;
(iv) a bulk commit for a (session_id, q_idx) with no stored proposal leaves `ai_proposed_score` NULL rather than echoing the committed score;
(v) `case-grade/commit` still writes `grade_type: "manual"` and does not set any of the three new columns.

Assertion (i) is the one that catches the defect you shipped — a test where proposed and committed are the same number proves nothing.

=== MUST NOT (unchanged) ===
No database connection of any kind. No `.env*`. No npm dependency. No `Co-Authored-By`. No push. Do not touch `lib/grades-upsert.ts`'s signature. Do not stage or commit the files another worker is concurrently editing in this worktree (`app/api/supa/handlers/*.ts`, `__tests__/ai-draft-preservation.test.ts`) — they belong to a different task.
